ActorTalk: The Kuroros here all seem to have been issued code that rendered them inoperative...
And... wait, this one's shell shows different wear patterns than the others.
So it doesn't belong to this area?
It was probably brought over from another area. If he's controlling these Kuroros... then this little guy might just be the breakthrough we've been looking for.
Every Kuroro has a traceability code. We can track the terminal to see where the last command was issued.
Scan Vision should be able to read it.
Let's give it a try. The perpetrator couldn't have gotten far. If we're lucky, maybe we can still catch up.
